therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Interferon-mediated immune modulation and direct antiproliferative effects
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Suppression of BCR-ABL positive clone proliferation and enhancement of immune surveillance
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Complete hematologic response, major cytogenetic response, and molecular response maintenance

results.effect_size: 40/41 participants maintained complete hematologic response, 40/41 maintained major cytogenetic response, 38/41 maintained molecular response
results.target_engagement_evidence: BCR-ABL transcript levels measured by RT-PCR showing molecular response in 38/41 participants
biomarker_changes: Philadelphia chromosome suppression maintained in 40/41 participants
results.dose_information: 90-450 mcg subcutaneously once weekly, dose adjusted as medically indicated

context.comparator: None - single arm expanded access study
